results.summary: zlib: integer overflow / buffer overread in inflate
results.details:
An integer overflow in zlib's inflate path can cause a buffer overread.
The same flaw is tracked against packaging wrappers (e.g. pyminizip) that
bundle zlib. The tracked range ends at 1.3.1 with no fixed release recorded
(last_affected), so an upgrade to a patched build is proposed rather than a
specific fixed version.

database_specific.pengyos_fixture_note:
The upstream registry tracks this overflow
  mostly via bundling packages (pyminizip); the fixture maps it onto the
  distro's zlib pin and uses a last_affected range to exercise the
  'no fixed release' path.
